name: tpl-not-co-existence-2-nogoal
task: Never both drop the key while the door is still closed and open the door.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the task is a single restriction — never both drop the key while the door is still closed and open the door — which the hard NotCoExistence(key_lost, door_open) captures exactly. key_lost only fires on a drop while door_open is false, so 'open the door' as the second side of the mutual exclusion matches the 'and open the door' wording. No goal is commanded (only a joint restriction), so the rule-only warning and empty FINAL_STATES are valid.

texts: key_lost and door_open never both happen during the episode
